filter.description: One CCN with a cost report in the HCRIS files used (ccn_count == 1; the crosswalk may list more, see multi_ccn_crosswalk), period-aligned, material (>=$1M both sides), same-scale (expense bases within 5%).

sources.cms: HCRIS Hospital 2552-10, FY2022 and FY2023 files; Worksheet S-10 (S100000 for periods beginning before 2022-10-01, S100001 Part I after)
sources.irs: Form 990 Schedule H, tax year 2022, e-file releases 2023-2026

fields.irs_7a: Schedule H Part I line 7a col (e), net community benefit expense
fields.irs_7a_gross: Schedule H Part I line 7a col (c), total community benefit expense
fields.irs_7a_offset: Schedule H Part I line 7a col (d), direct offsetting revenue
fields.irs_7b: Schedule H Part I line 7b (Medicaid) col (e); _gross is col (c), _offset col (d)
fields.cms_s10: Worksheet S-10 line 23 col 3, cost of charity care
fields.cms_s10_line5: Worksheet S-10 line 5, Medicaid DSH/supplemental payments net of provider taxes (can be negative)
fields.irs_7a_consistent: whether (c) - (d) = (e) within $1 on the return itself; null when (c) is blank
fields.ccns_with_cost_report: CCNs under the EIN that have a cost report in the HCRIS files used; always 1 in this index
fields.crosswalk_ccn_count: CCNs the CCN-EIN crosswalk lists for the EIN; can exceed ccns_with_cost_report
fields.multi_ccn_crosswalk: true when crosswalk_ccn_count > 1: the crosswalk lists further CCNs that have no cost report in the HCRIS files used
fields.notes: list of fixed codes (see note_codes) that apply to the row; mechanical facts for display, not judgements; empty list when none apply
fields.null: a null is a line with no value on the form, never a reported $0

note_codes.irs_7a_inconsistent: on the return itself, Schedule H line 7a (c) - (d) differs from (e) by more than $1,000 (a blank (d) is read as 0)
note_codes.irs_offset_reported: Schedule H line 7a col (d), direct offsetting revenue, is greater than 0
note_codes.cms_line5_reported: Worksheet S-10 line 5 has a value (positive or negative)
note_codes.multi_ccn_crosswalk: the crosswalk lists more than one CCN for this EIN; only one has a cost report in the HCRIS files used
note_codes.cms_report_as_submitted: the cost report's status is as submitted (not yet settled, amended or reopened)
note_codes.irs_amended_return: the 990 used is marked as an amended return
